implementation: Uncommitted codex/open-issues working tree; executable and source digests identify the measured implementation.
measurementLimits: Three samples per binary on the same runner; substantial build/extraction variance remains.
External CI preparation/orchestration and test execution are not measured.
Extraction and its module intervals overlap hierarchically; do not sum parent/child intervals.
Maximum RSS is the high-water value reported by /usr/bin/time, not a sum across processes.
The exploratory pre-byte-guard sample is excluded.
Swift Testing parameter uncertainty adds diagnostics and conservatively retains four requested excluded entry roots; this is separate from performance reuse.
